content.text: 2026 PGA Championship Travel PackagesAronimink Golf Club | Newtown Square, PAMay 11, 2026 - May 17, 2026Experience the second major of the 2026 golf season! Official 2026 PGA Championship ticket, experience, and hotel packages are now available from On Location, the Official Travel Package Provider of the PGA of America. Official 2026 PGA Championship Ticket & Hotel Packages1 Day Access 2026 PGA Championship Thursday Access Canopy by Hilton - Philadelphia Center CityRoundtrip Deluxe TransportationThursday Course Access Add-on Available1 Day Access 2026 PGA Championship Friday Access Canopy by Hilton - Philadelphia Center CityRoundtrip Deluxe TransportationFriday Course Access Add-On Available1 Day Access 2026 PGA Championship Saturday Access Canopy by Hilton - Philadelphia Center CityRoundtrip Deluxe TransportationSaturday Course Access Add-On Available 1 Day Access 2026 PGA Championship Sunday Access Canopy by Hilton - Philadelphia Center CityRoundtrip Deluxe TransportationSunday Course Access Add-on AvailableMilitary Admission PolicyTo honor the men and women who serve our country in the Armed Forces, the Championship is pleased to offer Active Duty, Retirees*, Reserve, National Guard, and their accompanying guest (limit one) complimentary daily grounds access to the Championship. In May 2026, qualifying individuals should visit pgachampionship.com to complete an online verification and request process where a copy of their Military ID or service verification must be provided in exchange for daily admission. Please note, Military tickets cannot be upgraded to alternative venues, but are eligible for the junior admission policy. Subject to availability. Further, Military tickets to do not gain access into private hospitality areas or clubs and do not receive access to the Championship+ Inclusive Food & Non-Alcoholic Beverage Program. *Career-retired with twenty years of qualifying military service and Department of Defense IDJunior Ticket InformationAs part of the Championship’s mission to grow interest and participation in the game of golf, juniors 15 years of age and younger will be admitted into the Championship grounds for free when accompanied by a ticketed adult. Each ticketed adult will be permitted two junior grounds admissions per day at no additional charge. Junior tickets may be picked up on-site at the Admissions Office located at the Main Spectator Entrance on the day of admission. Junior tickets cannot be obtained in advance and will be available regardless of a sell-out. Please note, junior tickets do not gain access into private hospitality areas or clubs and do not receive access to the Championship+ Inclusive Food & Non-Alcoholic Beverage Program. Children under the age of 2 do not require an admission ticket to enter the Championship. Ticket Packages for the PGA Championship On Location, the Official Travel Package Provider of the 2026 PGA Championship, is your source for the ultimate golf experience. Join us next year as the PGA Championship heads to the historic Aronimink Golf Club in Newtown Square, PA. Be there live to watch the game’s top players compete in golf’s second major of the year—right after The Masters.
